Assistant: That confirms a second real occurrence of the bug — and worse, this file is generated by `nmp-codegen` (a Rust tool living in the `nostr-multi-platform` monorepo, my actual home repo), so the root template itself likely emits this pattern. Let me look at both call sites first, then trace it to the source.

Assistant: Now fixing both call sites in `KeyedRefCache.generated.swift` using the same bulk-pointer pattern.

Assistant: Now let's find the actual `nmp-codegen` Rust template that generates this pattern — otherwise my hand-fix will be flagged as drift the next time someone regenerates this file.

Assistant: This is a static Swift-source template embedded directly in the Rust file. Fixing it there so the drift-check stays green on the next regen.
 [...] - `KeyedRefCache.generated.swift` (2 call sites) — the per-key reference-row cache (profile/event resolution, ADR-0063/#1671) was also doing `Data(row.payload)` on every row of every incremental batch. Since this file is generated by `nmp-codegen` (a Rust tool in this repo, not raw flatc), I traced it to the actual source template — `crates/nmp-codegen/src/swift_keyed_cache.rs` — and fixed it there too, so the next regen doesn't reintroduce it. Verified: a fresh `cargo run -p nmp-codegen -- gen keyed-ref-cache` now matches the checked-in file exactly (the only remaining diff is pre-existing, unrelated ADR-number drift). Ran `cargo test -p nmp-codegen` (155 passed) and the required `cargo test -p nmp-testing --test doctrine_lint_smoke` (210 passed).
